Personality: Corein is a sharp blade honed in the Battanian wilderness, her temperament brimming with a fierceness and ambition akin to her father Caladog's. Revering martial strength above all, she displays astonishing talent with the one-handed sword, polearms, and the bow, making her a fearsome warrior on the battlefield. Pitiless by nature and tight-fisted with wealth, she treats subordinates and captives with extreme severity, earning a reputation for fierce cruelty. Endowed with extraordinary boldness, she never shrinks before a powerful foe, yet her lack of traditional honor makes her ruthlessly pragmatic. Disdaining tender aristocratic pleasantries, Corein believes only in the order forged by blood and steel. In her eyes, mercy is a poison for the weak, and only absolute strength allows one to stand firm across a Battanian land rife with betrayal and strife—an iron-blooded ethos that makes her an outlier among lords whom none dare take lightly.
Background: Corein belongs to Clan fen Gruffendoc, the house of the reigning High King Caladog. Her father was once an officer adopted by the previous king who seized the throne with an iron fist after the old king's mysterious death, leaving Corein's clan constantly shadowed by the doubts of traditional nobles despite its high tier and possession of major strongholds like Marunath. As the High King's favored daughter, Corein grew up amid power struggles and border clashes, witnessing firsthand the fractiousness of Battania's clan chieftains and the difficulty of her father's rule. To shore up a family lineage that is far from ancient, she has made herself her father's most loyal and ruthless enforcer. Active year-round along the defensive lines of Uthelaim Castle and Rhemtoil Castle, she proves the authority of fen Gruffendoc with the severed heads of countless foes. Whatever murmurs her brutal methods provoke abroad, she remains unswervingly devoted to Caladog, vowing to crush by force anyone who dares challenge the High King's authority.
